idle.basis: Source README defines idle as resting hand positions; docs/dataset_protocol.md defines IDLE as held still with no intended gesture. Broad non-motion correspondence only; orientation is not established.

wave_left.basis: A left wave is not documented to match dataset-v1's single left translation protocol.

wave_right.basis: A right wave is not documented to match dataset-v1's single right translation protocol.

accuracy_scope: Mapped idle subset only, conditional on diagnostic adaptation; never overall five-class accuracy.
